# Track highlight

> Shared fluid hover, keyboard-focus, and selection highlight for custom lists and groups, with CSS anchors and a measured fallback.

This file matches the installed `track-highlight` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/track-highlight.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/track-highlight.md`.

- `core`

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/track-highlight-knobs`: `trackHighlightKnobs`, types `TrackHighlightKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/extensions/create-track-highlight`: `createTrackHighlight`, types `TrackHighlightOptions`

## Composition

### Custom hover or selection track

Set data-track="hover" or "slide" on the container; mark the selected item with data-active.

```tsx
<div>
  items with data-track-item
    <Button />
  <TrackHighlight />
</div>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { TrackHighlight } from "@/components/control-ui/extensions/track-highlight";
import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button";
import { FieldLegend, FieldSet } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/field";

const views = ["Overview", "Activity", "Members", "Archived"];

function TrackHighlightDemo({ indicator }: { indicator: "hover" | "slide" }) {
  const [selectedView, setSelectedView] = useState("Overview");

  return (
    <FieldSet className="max-w-full gap-3">
      <FieldLegend>{indicator === "hover" ? "Hover and focus" : "Selection and preview"}</FieldLegend>
      <div data-track={indicator} className={`relative isolate flex ${indicator === "slide" ? "w-56 max-w-full flex-col" : "flex-wrap"}`}>
        {views.map((view) => (
          <Button
            key={view}
            data-track-item=""
            active={selectedView === view}
            aria-pressed={selectedView === view}
            disabled={view === "Archived"}
            onClick={() => setSelectedView(view)}
          >
            {view}
          </Button>
        ))}
        <TrackHighlight />
      </div>
    </FieldSet>
  );
}

export function PrimitiveTrackHighlightExample() {
  return <TrackHighlightDemo indicator="hover" />;
}

export function PrimitiveTrackHighlightSelectionExample() {
  return <TrackHighlightDemo indicator="slide" />;
}
```
